subject: Request: Strategic 28% Hosted API Concession — Silvershore AI
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 11 Jun 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Silvershore — asking exec for 28% hosted API concession

Jordan / Steph,

Quick background: Silvershore (seed-to-series-B AI platform for maritime analytics) is evaluating Redwood for primary inference for their analytics pipeline. They've finished procurement review and are asking for a 28% consumption-based discount on Hosted API in exchange for a 24-month committed spend and a marketing/co-sell pilot. Key points from the customer: 
- Expected monthly usage ramp to ~45M tokens/month by Q4 (forecast attached).
- Willing to commit to a 2-year minimum ARR of $720k (hosted tokens + priority support).
- Wants table-stakes SLO language and the right to a dedicated support contact; procurement pushed an MSA redline.

Why they're strategic: strong healthcare & shipping vertical signals from their pilot customers, potential marketplace listing and a press case if we co-sell. They asked if we can do 28% off list for Hosted API (hosted consumption rate). Deal desk returned that >20% needs exec sanction.

Asking: can we get an exec sign-off for the 28% concession conditioned on a signed 24-month commitment, 60-day success milestones, and a co-sell/PR clause? I attached the MSA redlines and their usage forecast.

If you want the short pitch: they trade us exclusivity for certain verticals for 12 months and a joint case study.

Thanks — Ben

Attachments: Silvershore_MSA_redline_v1.pdf, Silvershore_usage_forecast_Q3-Q4.xlsx

Ben Carter
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0136

Mina — looping you for quick decision. TL;DR: Ben has a potential $720k ARR over 24 months, customer asks for 28% off Hosted API list. Deal desk flagged >20% requires exec approval.

Customer highlights: committed 24 months, ramp to significant volume by Q4, asks for SLO language and a co-sell/PR commitment. Deal team recommends approving the concession if we: 
1) Require a signed commitment (SOW + MSA) before discount effective date.
2) Add success milestones (30/60 days) that trigger marketing co-sell.
3) Keep legal review to ensure no expanded liability.

Ben — if you can add any downside risks I missed, call it out. Mina, your guidance here (approve/decline/conditions) appreciated — Ben is on a tight procurement timeline (they want paperwork this week).

— Jordan

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Jun 2029 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Silvershore — asking exec for 28% hosted API concession

Thanks for the context. I reviewed the forecast and the ask. I am comfortable authorizing the 28% hosted API concession on the following strict conditions: 

1) Contractual commitments: signed MSA + SOW for 24 months and a non-cancellable minimum ARR of $720,000. Discount only applies once both documents are fully executed.

2) Milestones & monitoring: define concrete 30/60-day success milestones in the SOW (onboarding completion, production inference with <500ms p90, and usage >= 20M tokens/month by day 60). Failure to meet milestones allows automatic reversion to standard list rates after a 30-day cure period.

3) Legal & Risk: Legal must sign off on redlines — in particular: no broad indemnities, standard limitation of liability remains, and data handling clauses must be scoped to Hosted API model (no special obligations beyond our standard privacy/SOC 2 controls).

4) Marketing/co-sell & PR: require a joint case study and co-sell engagement plan. Marketing will coordinate a short announcement only after the first success milestone passes.

5) Operational guarantees: Product/Infra to reserve burst capacity routing for the account during key workloads (documented in SOW). Finance: bill commit as monthly amortized credits against consumption. 

6) Executive visibility: deal desk to file a post-signature summary (usage trends, credit burn, and milestone progress) at 30/90/180 days.

If Legal and Finance agree with the structure above, consider this an approval. Ben/Jordan/Steph: proceed to prepare the concession paperwork and loop in Legal (cc'd below if needed). Also include a HubSpot note referencing deal HST-2029-0056 and tag me on the closing activity.

— Mina
